entities.summary: Salah Uddin Shoaib Choudhury is a Bangladeshi controversial journalist and fake news peddler who went on to become notorious for several crimes. In 2014, he was convicted of carrying documents provoking interreligious friction, and in 2015 of embezzlement. Fact-checkers have found Choudhury to have posted disinformation on various occasions. He is a prominent Muslim supporter of Israel. Salah Choudhury was a authors & novelists from Sylhet (b. 1965-01-12, Sylhet).
